description: This file defines a PHP class 'PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator' that implements a menu configuration for the Performance module in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up screen override behavior within the application's menu system.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures menu behavior for the performance tracking feature, overriding the screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker' and returns null.
